# Scholar's Pack (`equipment:scholars-pack`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md), [Equipment Packs](../equipment-categories/equipment-packs.md) | **Cost:** 40 gp | **Weight:** 22 lb.
**Contents:** [Backpack](../equipment/backpack.md), [Blanket](../equipment/blanket.md), [Book](../equipment/book.md), [Ink](../equipment/ink.md), [Ink Pen](../equipment/ink-pen.md), [Lamp](../equipment/lamp.md), 10x [Oil](../equipment/oil.md), 10x [Parchment](../equipment/parchment.md), [Tinderbox](../equipment/tinderbox.md)

A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Blanket, Book, Ink, Ink Pen, Lamp, 10 flasks of Oil, 10 sheets of Parchment, and Tinderbox.
